sections.title: The companion keeps conversational intuition and structured analytics perfectly aligned.
sections.body:
Behind every response application coordinates secure access to datasets and powers agile modelling, and async workers enrich results.
The LLM interprets intent, drafts strategy, and narrates outcomes—always with traceable artefacts you can revisit.

items.title: Conversation canvas
items.body: Multi-turn threads capture prompts, decisions, and supporting files. Filters make it effortless to revisit a critical hypothesis, a generated transformation plan, or a recommended experiment.

items.title: Model insight studio
items.body: Lightweight pipelines translate conversational intent into metrics, anomaly scans, and visuals across files, APIs, or web sources. The companion explains each step so everyone understands the why—not just the what.

items.title: Companion control tower
items.body: Async workers run heavy lifting in the background: schedule refreshes, fetch external signals, and push summaries downstream. Dashboards in the UI keep you aware of health, latency, and cost impact.
bullets: Cost and usage trackers per user

sections.title: Every layer communicates, so you never lose momentum.
sections.body:
When you ask the companion for help, it understands your objective, checks data availability, spins analyses with DuckDB,
and loops in worker automations. You stay focused on the narrative—even as complexity grows.

items.title: Consistency
items.body: Shared prompt libraries and response patterns keep analyses aligned, whether you are starting fresh or building on a teammate’s work.

items.title: Trust
items.body: Every suggestion links back to the source—whether it was a spreadsheet, API response, or worker-enriched snapshot. Audit trails remain a click away.

items.title: Moments of delight
items.body: Animated highlights and story cues draw attention to what matters, helping stakeholders grasp the narrative instantly.
